subject: How to survive a Super Bowl party
preheader: It's on Valentine's Day this year. You're going to need a plan.

props.content:
HOW TO SURVIVE A SUPER BOWL PARTY

Super Bowl LXI is this Sunday, February 14. Yes, Valentine's Day. Whether you're at a party or explaining to your date why there is a party, here's your five-minute prep.

[Fill in by Feb 1: who's playing, plus one storyline each. e.g. 'The Chiefs are back again. The Lions have never been here.']

1. PICK A SIDE BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

Someone will ask who you're rooting for. Go with your host's team, or the underdog. Neither needs explaining.

2. LEARN THREE LINES

  • "This is a big drive." When your team has the ball and the room goes quiet.
  • "Defense has to step up here." When the other team is getting close.
  • "That's a huge call." When a yellow flag flies and people yell at the TV.

3. CHEER HALF A SECOND LATE

Follow the room. Touchdown: stand up and yell. Field goal: polite clapping. Not sure? Check your host's face.

4. HALFTIME IS FREE TIME

"Which ad was your favorite?" is the safest question of the night. Ask anyone.

5. NEVER SAY

"Who's playing?" "Why do they keep stopping?" Anything involving the word "sportsball."
